releaseNotes:
LifeOS v3.2.7 (Build 64):
• AI Nutrition Auto-Calorie & Portion Logging: Users only specify what & how much they ate — AI automatically calculates and applies exact calories
• 150+ Verified Indian & Student Dishes Database: Instant 0ms offline calorie estimation for standard mess meals, gym food, and street snacks
• Multi-Item Meal Detection: Intelligently identifies composite meals (e.g. "2 rotis and 1 bowl dal") and logs each item with precise calories
• Real-Time Macro Breakdown: Displays estimated protein, carbs, and fats per serving and auto-scales with interactive portion steppers
